startScreen.title: Situationship
description: Answer what is true about the relationship now.
A label is optional. Honesty and boundaries are not.

endScreen.title: Clarity Found
endScreen.subtitle: Whatever this is, let it require less pretending after tonight.

reality.name: The Placeholder
reality.description: Are we a destination or a stop?

questions.question: When do you delay replying because seeming less interested feels safer than being clear?
What part of yourself do you edit to keep this connection easy?
After we spend time together, do you usually feel steadier, more anxious, or both?
Choose three recent emojis you are comfortable showing. What do they reveal about your week?
What assumption are you making about whether I am seeing other people?
If jealousy appeared, what agreement would it expose as missing?
How do you describe me when friends ask, and what do you leave out?
Describe the option you keep available in case this never becomes more.
Who has more power here: the person who cares less, or the person who is less honest about caring?
If one of us wanted more, what are you afraid would have to change?
Are we avoiding a label because it is too early, or because ambiguity benefits someone?
Hold eye contact for 20 seconds. Then each name what made it difficult or easy.
Am I part of the relationship you want, or a way to postpone looking for it?
If this ended, what explanation would be true but difficult to tell your friends?
If someone seemingly perfect arrived tomorrow, what would that reveal about your commitment here?
Ask the question you keep calling too dramatic.
